hotspots.name: Camp Painting
hotspots.description: A painting of the camp outside
hotspots.interactionText: You peek at the painting. It shows the camp outside! You head out!

uses.text: You peer through the telescope at the camp painting. The flying car is RIGHT THERE! 🔭
You look through binoculars at the painting. You can see the campfire smoke rising! 🔭

hotspots.name: Comfy Armchair
hotspots.interactionText: You sink into the big blue armchair. So cozy and warm in here!

uses.text: You curl up in the armchair with your hot cocoa. THIS IS PEAK COZY. ☕
You tuck Teddy Bear into the armchair by the fireplace. The house feels even cozier! 🧸
You prop the pillow behind your head in the armchair. A PERFECT nap spot! 🛏️
You munch a cookie in the big blue armchair. Crumbs everywhere! Worth it! 🍪
You stuff the sleeping bag into the armchair like a cozy nest. HIBERNATION MODE! 💤

hotspots.name: Big Wardrobe
hotspots.description: A tall brown wardrobe — who knows what's inside?
hotspots.interactionText: You open the wardrobe. It's FULL of coats and hats and mystery!

uses.text: You shine your flashlight into the dark wardrobe. There's a secret back wall! Is this NARNIA?! 🔦
You toss the rope over the wardrobe door. Now it's a climbing wall! 🪢
You hide the Moon Rock in the wardrobe. It glows between the coats. Magical! 🌑
Teddy Bear fits PERFECTLY in the wardrobe. Cosy Narnia bear! 🧸

hotspots.name: Dining Table
hotspots.description: A big dining table with chairs
hotspots.interactionText: You sit down at the dining table. Time for a proper meal!

uses.text: You eat your sandwich at the proper dining table like a distinguished camper. So fancy! 🥪
You place the apple in the fruit bowl on the table. A perfect centrepiece! 🍎
You have cookies for dessert at the dining table. The fanciest tea party ever! 🍪
You drink from your mug at the dining table. Very sophisticated! ☕
You bang the frying pan on the dining table like a dinner bell. DONG DONG! Dinner is served! 🍳

hotspots.name: Tea Corner
hotspots.description: A cozy corner with a pink mug
hotspots.interactionText: You find a pink mug in the cozy corner. Time for tea!

uses.text: You drop marshmallows into the tea. FLOATING MARSHMALLOW TEA! Absolutely delicious! 🍡
You mix the hot cocoa into your tea. A choccy-tea invention! The world is changed forever! ☕
You dunk the cookie into your tea. It gets perfectly soggy. GENIUS! 🍪

hotspots.name: Craft Table
hotspots.description: A big round table for making things
hotspots.interactionText: You sit at the big round craft table. So many things to make!

uses.text: You press the leaf onto paper with crayons. A beautiful leaf rubbing! Nature art! 🍃
You spread the star chart on the craft table and trace the constellations! ✨
You copy the map onto fresh paper with crayons. You made a TREASURE MAP! 🗺️
You dip the acorn in paint and stamp acorn shapes all over the paper! 🌰🎨
You draw a picture of the night sky using your telescope notes. An astronomical masterpiece! 🔭

hotspots.name: Kitchen Sink
hotspots.description: The kitchen sink with soap and sponges
hotspots.interactionText: Splish splash! The kitchen sink is great for washing up!

uses.text: You use both soaps in the kitchen sink. DOUBLE BUBBLES! The suds are EVERYWHERE! 🧼🫧
You rinse your toothbrush under the kitchen tap. Minty fresh! 🪥
You wash the raincoat in the kitchen sink. It comes out gleaming! 🧥

hotspots.name: Cozy Chair
hotspots.interactionText: You plop into the cozy blue-purple chair. It's the PERFECT sitting chair!

uses.text: You curl up in the cozy chair with your book. Best reading spot in the whole house! 📚
You wrap yourself in the sleeping bag in the cozy chair. The cosiest cocoon ever! 💤
You sit Teddy Bear in the cozy chair like royalty. The chair is now Teddy's throne! 🧸
You sip hot cocoa in the cozy chair. Outside it's camp. In here it's HEAVEN. ☕
